findings.issue: Roadmap README L0 (lines 430–450) defines `𝔤` as the represented Chevalley algebra inside `End V` and `I ⊂ 𝔤` there; main already has this as `TauCeti.F4ShortRoot.shortRootIdeal : LieIdeal (ZMod 2) (representedChevalleyAlgebra (ZMod 2))`. This PR builds a second short-root ideal `f4ShortRootLieIdeal` in `ZMod 2 ⊗[ℤ] f4ChevalleyLieLattice` (a sublattice of the Geck algebra `F4.lieAlgebra valid_F4`), and neither main nor the PR contains any map from that algebra to `representedChevalleyAlgebra`, to `F4ShortRoot.groupScheme`, or to the 26-dimensional module. The description explicitly says the represented construction 'is not used as a substitute', so the path from this ideal to the reeF4/tits isogeny runs through a bridge that does not exist and is not named.

summary: The material targets the reeF4/tits short-root ideal in CFSGStatement L0/L2, but it constructs that ideal in the reduced Geck Chevalley lattice, whereas the roadmap's `I ⊂ 𝔤` and main's carrier live in the represented 26×26 algebra, where `TauCeti.F4ShortRoot.shortRootIdeal` already exists; no bridge is supplied and the description does not state the path from the new ideal to the carrier isogeny. Single-topic is satisfied.
